# App workflows

These pages explain Agent Relay in terms of user goals. Each page separates work that the app performs in the background from decisions that require human attention.

A **verified** page is backed by a semantic Android emulator journey and reviewed screenshots. A **planned** page defines intended behavior without presenting fixture images as implemented product evidence.

## Workflow catalogue

- [Fresh start to first usable session](workflows/fresh-start-first-session.md) - **Verified.** Configure a secure host, review its identity, and open the first agent session.
- [Review an unknown or changed host identity](workflows/host-identity-review.md) - **Verified.** Keep a remote connection closed until its cryptographic host identity is explicitly reviewed.
- [Resolve an agent approval or question](workflows/attention-approval.md) - **Verified.** Move from an attention signal to a scoped, auditable provider response.
- [Switch sessions and steer active work](workflows/session-switching-steering.md) - **Verified.** Move between concurrent sessions without losing drafts, unread state, or active-turn controls.
- [Inspect and save a changed file](workflows/changed-file-export.md) - **Verified.** Export one provider-reported workspace file through Android's document picker.
- [Follow a notification to the required action](workflows/notification-attention.md) - **Planned.** Open the exact session and request that needs attention without searching through background work.
- [Recover after network, process, or device interruption](workflows/durable-recovery.md) - **Planned.** Restore useful state automatically and surface only recovery decisions that need a person.
- [Pair the phone with a durable host](workflows/qr-pairing.md) - **Planned.** Scan one host-generated QR code and establish an authenticated route when both devices share a network.
- [Capture and review offline voice input](workflows/voice-input.md) - **Planned.** Turn speech into a draft locally, then let the user review it before any agent receives it.
- [Review what needs attention across hosts](workflows/attention-overview.md) - **Verified.** See exceptional work first while healthy sessions and connections continue quietly.

## Evidence policy

- Captures use synthetic names, endpoints, sessions, commands, and files.
- Release builds contain no documentation fixture or hidden demonstration mode.
- UI actions use Compose semantics; captures come from Android instrumentation.
- Tests wait for asserted conditions instead of fixed sleeps.
- Pull requests retain the generated site, captures, and diffs as workflow artifacts.
